published_source_detail: Authors' Stata log shipped in the package (7. table 5c/Table 5c_log.pdf); article text not in the project, so printed table values are unverified.
replication_vs_log: exact (fixest = authors' reghdfe keepsing log to all printed digits; N and clusters match)
notes: controversies (count). Authors' code (7. table 5c/Table 5c.do, line 27): reghdfe totalcontro post_pri if j>-8 & j<6, a(wficn1 yearqtr) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. Sample: fund-quarter panel, opentonewinv==1 and row-count event quarter j in -7..5 (j counts panel rows from the first post-signing row, so it differs from calendar distance when a fund's panel has gaps). Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef -0.1826538 vs -0.1826538, N 3662 vs 3662, clusters 478 vs 478, SE 0.2034652 vs 0.2034652. Regression sample: N = 3662, 478 funds, 35 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 34, of which 30 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 34 of the 35 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 248 (32.1% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 20. Table/column labels are inferred from package folder names and code order (no article text).
